references.text: Jesus explains that he now speaks openly and no longer in "parables," and the disciples confirm that they understand what he says, which stands in direct contrast to the misunderstanding in 10:6.

The people ask Jesus directly if he is the Messiah, and Jesus answers that they do not believe because they are not of his flock, illustrating the same lack of understanding and spiritual insight as in 10:6.
John concludes that the people could not believe because Isaiah had said they were blinded, explaining the deep misunderstanding and failure to recognize Jesus' words described in 10:6.

Jesus asks why they do not understand his speech and answers that they do not hear his words because they are not from God, a direct parallel to the misunderstanding in 10:6 where they did not grasp what he was speaking about.
